LESSON: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making, part of Strand 10 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of note- making in reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to search online for information on note-making.

• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner organises own learning and makes notes after reading varied texts.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as the learner displays a team spirit while working with peers to draw mind maps.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Career guidance is enhanced as the learner reads and makes notes on types of music thereby exposing them to careers in music.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner develops the skill of note making which is relevant in the study of all subjects including Pre-Technical Studies.
